domain_label: Higgsfield Prompting & Model Ops — Video Prompt Craft per Model Family
purpose: A method for authoring video prompts per model family on the Higgsfield surface: Veo 3.1's five-part structure plus timestamp multi-shot syntax plus SFX/ambient audio lines, Kling's Subject+Movement+Scene blocks under the 2,500-character prompt/negative caps, MiniMax Director bracketed camera commands, Sora's storyboard-brief with one camera move and one action per shot, the image-to-video motion-only rule from official Runway guidance, start+end-frame keyframe practice, the one-axis iteration protocol with seed control held honestly at its unknowns, and per-model-class failure modes with prompt-level mitigations — every model id, duration, aspect ratio and media role quoted only from the live MCP enumeration, never from memory.
assumptions: no generations were run and no credits spent; all scores are heuristic priors; every Higgsfield platform fact (model ids, durations, aspect ratios, media roles, parameter names) comes from the live MCP surface enumeration of 2026-07-03 in higgsfield_surface.md, never from memory

the Veo 3.1 prompting guide (Google Cloud official blog), the Sora 2 prompting guide (OpenAI Cookbook via GitHub raw) and a mirror of Google's Imagen guide were fetched in full; official pages for Runway, Kling, MiniMax, Midjourney, BFL/FLUX and Seedream were 403-blocked and their content is carried via search excerpts quoting those pages — treated one notch below fully-fetched FACT and flagged for re-verification from an unblocked network
Sora prompting craft is documented even though no Sora model appears in this account's MCP catalog (has_more:false on all model lists); the pattern is transferable craft, not a callable route here

no engagement statistics, platform policies, legal cases or psychology effect sizes are claimed anywhere in this KB; the only failure-taxonomy citation is the arXiv AI-video-evaluation survey excerpt the research file carries
exclusions: still-image prompt anatomy beyond what video keyframes require (subject/context/style skeletons, lens tables) — that is the image-prompting KB's surface
credit costs, rate limits and plan gating of the Higgsfield surface beyond the get_cost:true preflight fact — cost ops belong to the model-ops/budget KB

music and sound-effect GENERATION mechanics (the surface's generate_audio is speech-only and music/SFX models are game-pipeline-only); this KB covers only in-prompt SFX/ambient TEXT lines for video models with native audio
any guidance for evoking a specific real person's likeness while hiding or obscuring the face — that lane is closed and stays closed; no workaround prompting is described

glossary.definition: Veo 3.1's official prompt order [Cinematography] + [Subject] + [Action] + [Context] + [Style & Ambiance], from the fetched Google Cloud 'Ultimate prompting guide for Veo 3.1' [FACT - fetched official blog].

Veo's [mm:ss-mm:ss] segment syntax that paces multiple shots inside one generation (e.g. [00:00-00:02] Medium shot... [00:02-00:04] Reverse shot... SFX: ...); the strongest documented duration-control device [FACT - fetched Veo guide].

Veo audio syntax: dialogue in quotation marks, a dedicated 'SFX:' line for effects (SFX: thunder cracks in the distance) and an 'Ambient noise:' line for beds (Ambient noise: the quiet hum of a starship bridge) [FACT - fetched Veo guide].

Kling's official text-to-video structure Subject + Subject Movement + Scene + (Camera Language + Lighting + Atmosphere), with prompt AND negative prompt each capped at 2,500 characters [FACT - official Kling guide content via search excerpt; direct fetch 403-blocked].

MiniMax/Hailuo's 15 bracketed camera commands ([Truck left/right], [Pan left/right], [Push in]/[Pull out], [Pedestal up/down], [Tilt up/down], [Zoom in/out], [Shake], [Tracking shot], [Static shot]); same-bracket commands act simultaneously (about 3 max recommended), sequential brackets apply in order [FACT - platform.minimax.io content via search excerpt].

Sora 2's prompting frame: brief a cinematographer who has never seen your storyboard — prose scene description, then cinematography (framing, mood), then action beats as bullets, then a dialogue block; each shot carries one clear camera move and one clear subject action [FACT - fetched OpenAI Cookbook guide].

Official Runway guidance that image-to-video prompts 'focus almost exclusively on motion': the input image establishes the visual starting point, and re-describing its content can lead to reduced motion or unexpected results [FACT - official Runway help-center content via search excerpt; direct fetch 403-blocked].

Supplying both a first and last keyframe so the model generates the transition between them (Veo 3.1 'first and last frame', Kling start/end mode); practice: match the two frames in palette, tone and setting; shorter clips interpolate more cleanly and dramatic jumps cause flicker [FACT - fetched Veo guide + partner-guide excerpts].

The over-smooth, retouched-default skin rendering caused by training on beauty-filtered photos; countered by demanding visible pores, fine lines and uneven tone, real optics, and directional side light instead of flat ring light [FACT - concordant practitioner guides via search].

Sora's editing doctrine 'Editing is for nudging, not gambling. Use it to make controlled changes - one at a time', combined with N>=2 samples per variant because the same prompt yields different results by design [FACT - fetched OpenAI Cookbook guide].

nodes.definition: Write photorealism in, plastic out. conflict_axes.name: full_scene_prose_vs_motion_only_budget
conflict_axes.description: Text-to-video formulas (Veo five-part, Kling blocks) reward rich scene description, while the image-to-video contract says re-describing the start image reduces motion.
poles: describe the whole scene in text
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: the presence of a start image flips the regime: t2v gets the full formula, i2v gets motion-only with the scene carried by the image

conflict_axes.name: single_beat_clips_vs_in_generation_multishot
conflict_axes.description: The one-move-one-action rule caps each clip's ambition, while Veo timestamps and cinematic_studio multi_shots invite packing several shots into one generation.
poles: one move and one action per clip
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: multi-shot only via explicit segmentation where each segment still carries one move and one action; otherwise split clips

conflict_axes.name: verbatim_identity_text_vs_lean_video_prompt
conflict_axes.description: Identity wants the character block repeated verbatim everywhere, but the i2v prompt budget belongs to motion.
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: identity text lives in the keyframe STILL prompts and in Soul/Element conditioning; the video prompt never re-describes the persona

conflict_axes.name: formula_coverage_vs_callable_catalog
conflict_axes.description: The research carries formulas (Sora; Director brackets) whose callable status on this account is absent or untested, tempting routing beyond the surface.
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: the live catalog is authoritative for routing; non-callable formulas are kept as transferable craft with their availability caveats attached

conflict_axes.name: hype_quality_tokens_vs_concrete_optics
conflict_axes.description: Legacy habit stacks quality tokens (ultra-realistic, 8K, masterpiece) while modern natural-language models respond better to concrete optics, film stock and light physics — a model-class-dependent trade.
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: default to concrete optics and light on modern families; treat token stacking as a legacy-model exception, and A/B before trusting either on a new model

conflict_axes.name: long_negative_blocks_vs_wanted_detail
conflict_axes.description: A thorough negative list removes recurring artifacts but long negatives can suppress detail the positive prompt asked for, and some models (FLUX.2) take none at all.
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: start from the studio block, prune to artifacts actually observed on that model, and use content-word or --no forms where no field exists

conflict_axes.name: stochastic_variation_vs_controlled_ab
conflict_axes.description: Same-prompt variation is documented as a feature, but controlled iteration needs attributable comparisons — and seed availability on this surface is unknown.
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: exploration phases may ride variation; judgment phases require N>=2 samples per variant and one changed axis, upgraded to seed-locking only if the schema read reveals seed support

conflict_axes.name: invisible_match_cut_vs_designed_mismatch
conflict_axes.description: Chained keyframes can hide cuts via near-matched frames or exploit mismatches as whip-pan/match-cut transitions — opposite treatments of the same seam.
poles: deliberate mismatch as a transition device
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: choose per cut and record the choice in the reel plan; never let a mismatch happen by accident, because unplanned seams read as jump-cut errors

conflict_axes.name: detailed_control_vs_creative_latitude
conflict_axes.description: Sora's own guide states detailed prompts buy control and consistency while lighter prompts open space for creative outcomes — a per-shot dial, not a fixed style.
poles: light prompt with room to surprise
conflict_axes.resolution_hint: hero and continuity shots get detailed prompts; mood-exploration shots get light ones, with the choice stated so results are judged against the right intent

edge_cases.description: An i2v prompt re-describes the persona and setting already in the start image and the clip comes back nearly frozen
edge_cases.trigger: the five-part or block formula is reused unmodified on an image-conditioned shot
edge_cases.mitigation: strip static description, keep only subject motion + camera move + tempo, and re-generate; the official wrong/right handshake pair is the template

edge_cases.description: A Kling prompt or negative silently exceeds the 2,500-character cap and the tail is lost or the call rejected
edge_cases.trigger: stacked style prose or a maximal negative block on kling3_0
edge_cases.mitigation: budget both texts under 2,500 characters at authoring time and prune negatives to observed artifacts

edge_cases.description: Five MiniMax commands are packed into one bracket and the camera executes a muddled simultaneous move
edge_cases.trigger: more than about three commands share a bracket
edge_cases.mitigation: cap simultaneous commands at ~3 and express sequences as ordered separate brackets

edge_cases.description: A minimax_hailuo keyframe shot is configured at resolution 512 with an end_image, which the surface declares incompatible
edge_cases.trigger: resolution 512 selected on an end-frame shot or with a 2.3 variant
edge_cases.mitigation: keep 768/1080 for keyframe work on minimax_hailuo, per the declared constraint

edge_cases.description: An end-frame storyboard is routed to veo3_1, which on this account accepts start_image only
edge_cases.trigger: the flagship Veo name is chosen without reading its media roles
edge_cases.mitigation: route end-frame shots to the both-frames list (veo3_1_lite, kling3_0, cinematic_studio, seedance, wan2_7)

edge_cases.description: Start and end keyframes differ in palette and lens and the interpolation flickers or morphs instead of cutting
edge_cases.trigger: keyframes authored in different sessions or grades are paired
edge_cases.mitigation: check palette, lens and grade match before generation; if the transition feels off, make the frames closer in style and shorten the clip

edge_cases.description: A negative block is sent to FLUX.2, which does not support negative prompts at all
edge_cases.trigger: the studio negative habit is applied across models without checking support
edge_cases.mitigation: on FLUX.2 describe wanted content only; keep negatives for models with a documented field or --no form

edge_cases.description: Two prompt variants are judged on one sample each and sampling noise is mistaken for a prompt effect
edge_cases.trigger: an A/B verdict drawn from a single generation per variant
edge_cases.mitigation: require N>=2 samples per variant (count param allows up to 4) before attributing a difference to the changed axis

edge_cases.description: A plan promises seed-locked reproducibility on Higgsfield, but seed exposure is an unresolved UNKNOWN on this surface
edge_cases.trigger: reproducibility assumptions imported from other vendor APIs
edge_cases.mitigation: condition all reproducibility claims on the schema read; until then plan around stochastic sampling

edge_cases.description: A hero portrait prompt contains 'flawless skin' and ring-light wording and renders with the plastic AI look
edge_cases.mitigation: replace with texture demands (visible pores, fine lines, uneven tone) and directional side light with named source/direction/quality/color

edge_cases.description: Veo timestamp syntax is pasted into a Kling or Seedance prompt where nothing documents it, and the bracketed times render as literal content or are ignored
edge_cases.mitigation: keep timestamps Veo-only; for multi-shot elsewhere use kling3_0's multi-shot strength or cinematic_studio_video_v2's multi_shots param, or split clips

edge_cases.description: A 5 s clip is asked to carry three actions and a camera orbit, and the motion comes back rushed and physics-breaking
edge_cases.trigger: multi-event ambition packed into a short duration
edge_cases.mitigation: cut to one camera move + one beat-counted action per clip and spread the story across chained clips or timestamp segments

workflow.description: Confirm the candidate model's duration set, aspect ratios, media roles and prompt-relevant params against the live enumeration
workflow.gate: every capability the shot needs appears in the enumeration; nothing is assumed from memory

workflow.action: Select the family formula for the routed model
workflow.description: Pick the Veo five-part, Kling block, MiniMax bracket or brief-style template matching the model family, with its provenance tier noted
workflow.gate: no cross-ported syntax; excerpt-sourced formulas carry their re-verification flag

workflow.action: Write the camera move as explicit text
workflow.description: Name the move with documented vocabulary (or route via preset/speedramp/motion_control) instead of vague style words
workflow.gate: an explicit camera term is present; the word 'cinematic' does not substitute for a move

workflow.action: Compose the Veo prompt with audio and pacing devices where routed to Veo
workflow.description: Assemble the five parts in order, add quoted dialogue / SFX / Ambient noise lines if audio is on, and timestamp segments if multi-beat
workflow.gate: five parts in order; audio lines only on audio-enabled routes; segments sum to 4, 6 or 8 s

workflow.action: Compose the Kling prompt within its caps where routed to Kling
workflow.description: Assemble Subject + Movement + Scene + (Camera + Lighting + Atmosphere), with prompt and negative each under 2,500 characters
workflow.gate: block order respected and both texts within the cap

workflow.action: Compose bracketed camera commands where routed to MiniMax
workflow.description: Express the move with the 15-command set, max ~3 per bracket, ordered brackets for sequences, pass-through flagged as untested
workflow.gate: only documented commands used; bracket limits respected

workflow.action: Strip re-description when a start frame exists
workflow.description: Convert the prompt to motion-only: subject motion + camera move + tempo, ~10% atmosphere continuation
workflow.gate: no clause re-describes static start-image content

workflow.action: Prepare and match the keyframe pair for interpolation shots
workflow.description: Author or select start and end frames matched in palette, lens and grade; choose light vs narrated prompt; confirm the model sits on the both-frames list
workflow.gate: frames match on palette/lens/grade and the model accepts both roles in the target duration

workflow.action: Bake identity and texture into the keyframe stills
workflow.description: Carry the verbatim character block, Soul/Element conditioning, texture demands and four-part light discipline in the still prompts that make the frames
workflow.gate: no plastic-causing words; identity lever compatible with the still model; character block verbatim

workflow.action: Generate N>=2 and iterate one axis at a time
workflow.description: Sample at least two per variant, diagnose against the six failure classes, change exactly one named axis, log the change and outcome
workflow.gate: one axis per iteration; no verdict from single samples; seed assumptions absent until the schema read

workflow.action: Apply the class-matched mitigation on rejection
workflow.description: Route the diagnosed class to its prompt-level fix (camera+beat, fewer events, reference conditioning, hands framing, front-loading)
workflow.gate: the applied fix matches the logged class

workflow.description: Confirm routing (surface defaults plus constraint overrides), formula conformance, keyframe/identity/negative plans, and clear the no-go list
workflow.gate: all no-go conditions clear; every claim traces to a surface fact, a sourced formula, or a named UNKNOWN

priority_rationale: The foundations come first because everything else is read against them: the per-family-formula frame, the live-surface ground truth that no model fact may bypass, and the fact that camera control is text-borne. The family formula nodes (Veo five-part with audio and timestamps, Kling blocks under their caps, MiniMax brackets, the Sora brief with its availability caveat) then instantiate the frame. The image-conditioned stack follows (motion-only contract, matched keyframes, eligibility partition, reel chaining) because it is where most production shots live. Craft nodes (beats, anti-plastic wording, negatives, character blocks) refine every prompt, and the iteration and failure nodes close the loop that turns rejections into single targeted changes. The routing verdict comes last because it composes every upstream constraint into a per-shot go/no-go that spends credits only on shots the surface can actually honor.

dominance_rules.rule: The live MCP surface dominates memory, marketing and vendor docs for anything callable
dominance_rules.rationale: model ids, durations, ratios and media roles were enumerated on 2026-07-03 and marketing names models (Sora) the account cannot call
dominance_rules.trigger: a shot plan names a model, duration, ratio or media role
dominance_rules.action: quote the enumeration; on any doubt re-run models_explore rather than assume

dominance_rules.rule: The motion-only contract dominates every scene-description formula when a start image exists
dominance_rules.rationale: official Runway guidance says re-describing image content reduces motion — the exact failure the reel format cannot afford
dominance_rules.trigger: an image-conditioned shot is being prompted
dominance_rules.action: drop subject/scene description and spend the prompt on motion, camera and tempo

dominance_rules.rule: One move and one beat-counted action dominate narrative ambition per clip
dominance_rules.rationale: multi-event asks in short clips are the top cause of rushed, physics-breaking motion
dominance_rules.trigger: a 3-6 s clip's draft contains more than one event or camera move
dominance_rules.action: cut to one move + one action, and move extra beats to timestamp segments or additional clips

dominance_rules.rule: Explicit camera terms dominate vague style words
dominance_rules.rationale: no camera parameter exists on any schema, so text is the control channel and 'cinematic' steers nothing
dominance_rules.trigger: a prompt's camera intent is expressed as a mood word
dominance_rules.action: replace with a named move (slow dolly-in, tracking shot, [Push in]) from the documented vocabularies

dominance_rules.rule: Keyframe palette/lens/grade match dominates prompt cleverness in interpolation shots
dominance_rules.rationale: dramatic jumps between mismatched frames cause flicker that no prompt text repairs
dominance_rules.action: fix the frames first (or re-author the end frame), then keep the prompt light

dominance_rules.rule: A named UNKNOWN dominates a convenient assumption
dominance_rules.rationale: seed exposure, internal prompt enhancement, Sora availability and the full Elements video list are all explicitly unresolved in the research
dominance_rules.trigger: a plan needs seed control, literal template transfer, a Sora route, or element support on an unlisted model
dominance_rules.action: carry the blocker and its resolution path (schema read, probe clip, re-enumeration); never invent the capability

dominance_rules.rationale: timestamps are documented for Veo only, brackets for Director-capable MiniMax only, and FLUX.2 takes no negatives
dominance_rules.trigger: a device from one family appears in another family's prompt
dominance_rules.action: remove it and use that family's own device (multi_shots, block order, content-word exclusions)

dominance_rules.rule: Texture demands and light physics dominate beauty language in photoreal shots
dominance_rules.rationale: retouched-default training makes 'flawless/perfect/smooth' wording produce the plastic look the vertical must avoid
dominance_rules.trigger: a hero portrait or persona keyframe is being worded
dominance_rules.action: demand pores/fine lines/uneven tone and name light source, direction, quality and color contrast

anti_rework_rules.rule: Read the target model's media roles and duration set before storyboarding any keyframe pair
anti_rework_rules.prevents: authoring an end-frame storyboard for a start-only model (veo3_1) and redoing the board or the route

anti_rework_rules.rule: Curate the start frame image-first before buying any i2v motion
anti_rework_rules.prevents: spending video generations on a composition the still pass would have rejected for free-er

anti_rework_rules.rule: Lock each persona's character block verbatim before the first batch
anti_rework_rules.prevents: paraphrase-drift identity changes that force re-shooting whole shot sets

anti_rework_rules.rule: Character-budget Kling prompts and negatives during authoring, not after rejection
anti_rework_rules.prevents: silent truncation at the 2,500-char caps and a mis-diagnosed 'model ignored my prompt' loop

anti_rework_rules.rule: Match the next clip's start frame to the previous final frame (lens, light, grade) before generating clip N+1
anti_rework_rules.prevents: a reel full of accidental jump cuts that needs whole-chain regeneration

anti_rework_rules.rule: Size dialogue and beats to the clip duration before generating
anti_rework_rules.prevents: rushed line delivery and clipped actions that force timing rewrites and re-runs

anti_rework_rules.rule: Start the prompt-change log with the first generation, not after problems appear
anti_rework_rules.prevents: unreproducible wins and re-discovering phrasing that already worked

anti_rework_rules.rule: Preflight get_cost:true and the duration clamp on each model+duration cell before batch runs
anti_rework_rules.prevents: burning budget on clamped durations or mispriced batches discovered mid-reel

iteration_protocol.trigger: a generated clip is close but flawed on one visible dimension
iteration_protocol.action: change exactly one named axis (lens, light direction, action verb, palette, camera move), regenerate N>=2, log the outcome

iteration_protocol.trigger: a clip comes back frozen or with minimal motion
iteration_protocol.action: strip any start-image re-description, add an explicit camera command plus one beat-counted action, and regenerate

iteration_protocol.trigger: flicker or morphing appears in an interpolation or between chained clips
iteration_protocol.action: tighten the keyframe match (palette/lens/grade), shorten the clip, and remove surplus camera directions
re-assert the verbatim character block in the keyframe stills and re-check Soul/Element conditioning against the compatible-model lists

iteration_protocol.trigger: output reads plastic or CG despite correct composition
iteration_protocol.action: add texture demands and directional light physics, remove beauty words and hype tokens, and prune the negative block for that model

iteration_protocol.trigger: a models_explore re-read shows changed models, params, roles or durations
iteration_protocol.action: diff the enumeration, update the surface, eligibility and routing nodes, and re-check every affected shot card

iteration_protocol.trigger: a blocked official guide (Runway, Kling, MiniMax, Midjourney, BFL, Seedream) becomes fetchable
iteration_protocol.action: verify the excerpt-carried formulas verbatim, upgrade or correct their provenance tags, and adjust any rule the verification changes

iteration_protocol.trigger: the live schema read or a probe clip resolves seed exposure or internal prompt enhancement
iteration_protocol.action: update the iteration protocol (seed-locked A/B if available) and re-state how literally the family templates transfer
